title: SM-1 vs. an Active Comparator in A Model of Transient Insomnia
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the effectiveness, safety and tolerability of a combination drug product (SM-1) containing diphenhydramine, zolpidem and lorazepam, in adult participants who sometimes have difficulty in falling asleep or staying asleep, but who do not have chronic insomnia. Participants will receive SM-1 or a combination of diphenhydramine and lorazepam during 2 one-night stays at a sleep center.
